title: Prevention and detection mechanisms
description: Principles are generic mechanisms (keep things apart, keep redundancy, verify independently, check regularly, monitor, maintain periodically); specific mechanisms refine them. Mechanisms reduce the likelihood or the impact of threats (prevention) or make an incident visible (detection). A structural mechanism is a property of the setup itself and is recognised in the plan with `present_when` (an expression on the target entity). A procedural mechanism is something people do; it is made of recovery actions (`procedure`) and repeated on a `schedule`. Which threats a mechanism helps against is stored here (`addresses`), not in the threat catalogue.

every_fraction_of_delay.description: Repeat after this fraction of the longest timelock of the target wallet.

trigger.description: continuous: automated, not performed by a person.

effect.description: eliminates: the threat can no longer occur or no longer has an impact. reduces: it becomes harder, rarer or milder. detects: the incident becomes visible (detection mechanisms). Detection says when the signal can appear, `schedule` says how often it is looked at.

when.description: Optional restriction to lifecycle phases of the threat.

form.description: principle: an abstract, generic mechanism that is only described and refined by others; it has no kind, target or addresses. structural: a property of the setup. procedural: something people do.

refines.description: The principle this mechanism is a specific form of. Threats are linked only on the refining mechanism, never on the principle.

target.description: Class of the entity the mechanism protects or is attached to.

covers.description: Which threat instances the mechanism acts on. self: threats whose footprint (target, affected entities, the wallets hit and what they depend on, and the places of all these) contains the target entity; a mechanism on a person or on the plan counts everywhere. own: only if the footprint contains the very entity, also for people and the plan. quorum: the mechanism acts when a signing device takes part in signing, so it protects a wallet only if every group of signers that can spend contains a device that has it (worst case: the group without it is used).

covers_when.description: Instead of `covers`: an expression on the target entity (`$self`) and the footprint of the threat instance (`$footprint`, a list of entity ids) that says when the mechanism acts on the instance.

strength_from.description: Structural prevention whose protection is read from a measure of the setup instead of from the effect: quorum_travel_minutes = the least journey a person needs to bring together a group of signers that can spend at once (Ratings protection.travel_minutes). The mechanism is present where the measure reaches the first band.

quorum_group.description: Only with covers: quorum. Mechanisms of one group do the same check in different ways; a signer group is covered if it has a device that has any of them.

barrier_for.description: Exploit kinds (Ratings protection.exploits) against which a prevention counts with the values of Ratings protection.after_delay when it is present on the wallet: a measure that keeps the funds from ever reaching the delay of a policy.

weakened_when.description: The protection is lowered by `delta` when the expression holds for the threat instance (`$self` is the target entity; `can` with agent attacker sees what leaked). Used for a tripwire that is recognised.

present_when.description: Structural only: an expression on the target entity that tells the mechanism is in place.

applies_when.description: Procedural only: an expression on the target entity under which the procedure is possible or meaningful (e.g. the device supports it).

implicit_when.description: Procedural only: an expression on the target entity under which the procedure happens anyway, because of how the entity is used (a device in regular use is powered on and noticed when it fails); no practice is needed then.

procedure.description: Procedural only: recovery actions that are carried out, in order.

signal.description: Detection only: what is observed when the threat has struck.
